calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, MIN(period_start_date) AS q_start, MAX(period_end_date) AS q_end
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_quarter,
    s.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS store_count,
    SUM(r.net_sales) AS total_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
  AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
  AND r.store_id < 900
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, s.region
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, s.region

WITH q3_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.region,
    SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.region
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, region
  FROM q3_sales
  GROUP BY store_id, region
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
)
SELECT 
    qs.fiscal_year,
    lfl.region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qs.store_id) AS lfl_store_count,
    SUM(qs.net_sales) AS lfl_net_sales
FROM q3_sales qs
JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON qs.store_id = lfl.store_id AND qs.region = lfl.region
GROUP BY qs.fiscal_year, lfl.region
ORDER BY qs.fiscal_year DESC, lfl.region

WITH q3_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.region,
    SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')
    AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.region
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id, region
  FROM q3_sales
  GROUP BY store_id, region
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
lfl_regional_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    qs.fiscal_year,
    lfl.region,
    SUM(qs.net_sales) AS regional_net_sales
  FROM q3_sales qs
  JOIN lfl_stores lfl ON qs.store_id = lfl.store_id AND qs.region = lfl.region
  GROUP BY qs.fiscal_year, lfl.region
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN regional_net_sales END) AS q3_2024_25_sales,
    MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN regional_net_sales END) AS q3_2025_26_sales
  FROM lfl_regional_sales
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  q3_2024_25_sales,
  q3_2025_26_sales,
  ROUND(((q3_2025_26_sales - q3_2024_25_sales) / q3_2024_25_sales * 100), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY region
